若只显示源码，确认扩展已启用及网站权限，或在篡改猴实用工具中从复制的脚本地址安装: If you only see source code, check extension and site permissions, or install from the copied URL using Tampermonkey utilities.
返回 EViewer 刷新页面，确认助手已连接，再选择本机助手。: Return to EViewer, refresh the page and confirm the assistant is connected before selecting local mode.
更新沿用相同脚本名称与地址。迁移后停用旧版 EViewer 原站登录脚本和实验连: Updates keep the same script name and URL. Disable the old EViewer login script and experimental connectors after migration to prevent duplicate execution.
助手只响应本站的画廊、账户配置、收藏及图片搜索请求；图片阅读仍由浏览器直接加载。: The assistant handles this site’s gallery, account settings, favorites and image-search requests. Reader images load directly in the browser. It does not forward requests for other users.
本机模式使用扩展可访问的源站会话。只有在服务代理模式主动发起原站授权并确认时，才: Local mode uses the source session available to the extension. Login credentials are encrypted and transferred only when you start and confirm source authorization in server proxy mode.
浏览器扩展需要你确认安装及网站权限，网页无法静默安装。自动更新由脚本管理器执行；: You must confirm extension installation and site permissions; websites cannot install silently. Your script manager handles automatic updates. EViewer checks on startup and reports version mismatches.
在同一浏览器登录 E-Hentai，再检测登录状态。本机请求使用源站会话，不向服: Sign in to E-Hentai in the same browser, then check the session. Local requests use that session without sending cookies to the server proxy.

桌面 Chrome、Edge、Firefox 等；支持扩展的 Android 浏: Desktop Chrome, Edge, Firefox and more; Android browsers with extension support.
iPhone、iPad 和 Mac 上的 Safari。: Safari on iPhone, iPad and Mac.
请在 Safari 普通标签页中安装并使用助手。: Install and use the assistant in a regular Safari tab.
请在支持扩展的 Firefox 或 Edge 中安装并使用助手。: Install and use the assistant in Firefox or Edge with extension support.
请在支持扩展的浏览器普通标签页中安装并使用助手。: Install and use the assistant in a regular tab in a browser with extension support.
一份助手，同时支持本机请求和源站登录授权。: One assistant for local requests and source login authorization.
打开 Userscripts App 选择脚本目录，再在 Safari 设置中启: Open the Userscripts app to choose a script directory, then enable the extension in Safari settings.
已安装可跳过；按扩展提示开启“允许用户脚本”或开发者模式。: Skip if already installed. Follow the extension prompt to allow user scripts or enable developer mode.
打开脚本后，在 Safari 扩展菜单选择 Userscripts，确认安装或更: Open the script, choose Userscripts from Safari’s extension menu, then confirm installation or update.
在 Tampermonkey 安装页确认安装或更新。: Confirm installation or update on the Tampermonkey install page.
当前安装的是开发或预览版；正式版请前往正式站点安装。: This installs a development or preview script. Visit the production site for the production version.
只保留一份助手，停用旧版登录脚本和实验连接器。: Keep one assistant enabled. Disable old login scripts and experimental connectors.
允许扩展访问本站和 E-Hentai，刷新本页后点击“重新检测”；连接成功即可选: Allow access to this site and E-Hentai, refresh this page, then select “Check again”. Once connected, you can choose “Local assistant”.
将下载的 .user.js 文件存入 Userscripts App 选定的目录: Save the downloaded .user.js file in the directory selected in the Userscripts app, then reopen the extension menu to refresh the list. Keep the .user.js extension; do not save it as a web page or .txt.
先检查扩展已启用及网站权限，也可复制地址，在 Tampermonkey 的“实用: Check that the extension is enabled and has site access. You can also copy the URL and install it in Tampermonkey’s Utilities tab.
助手通过当前浏览器访问 E-Hentai，仅处理你在本站发起的请求。: The assistant accesses E-Hentai through this browser and only handles requests you initiate on this site.
本机模式使用源站会话；仅在你确认服务代理的源站登录授权时，同步登录凭据。: Local mode uses your source session. Credentials are synced only when you confirm source login authorization for the server proxy.
安装与权限需手动确认。脚本管理器负责自动更新，EViewer 启动时检查线上版本: Confirm installation and permissions manually. The script manager handles automatic updates; EViewer checks the deployed version on startup.
请前往设置更新浏览器助手，以支持 HentaiVerse 本机请求: Update the browser assistant in Settings to enable local HentaiVerse requests
HentaiVerse 登录态已失效，请在当前连接模式下重新登录: Your HentaiVerse session has expired. Sign in again using the current connection mode
HentaiVerse 使用当前浏览器的源站会话。首次使用请更新助手，并在同一浏: HentaiVerse uses this browser's source-site session. Update the assistant, then open the source site in the same browser to confirm you are signed in.
HentaiVerse 未返回战斗数据，请打开源站确认登录后恢复战斗: HentaiVerse did not return battle data. Open the source site to check your login, then restore the battle
请先在账号信息中完成当前连接模式的登录验证。: Verify your login for the current connection mode in Account first.
画廊和 HentaiVerse 均使用所选连接方式。本机请求失败后不会自动切回服: Galleries and HentaiVerse use the selected connection. Local request failures do not switch to the server proxy.
在同一浏览器登录所选画廊站点，再检测登录状态。本机请求使用源站会话，不向服务代理: Sign in to the selected gallery site in the same browser, then check your session. Local requests do not sync cookies to the server proxy.
允许扩展访问本站及所选源站，刷新本页后点击“重新检测”；连接成功即可选择“本机助: Allow the extension to access this site and the selected source site, refresh, then check the connection and choose Local assistant.
本机模式通过脚本从当前浏览器访问所选画廊站点。: Local mode accesses the selected gallery site through a userscript in this browser.
ExHentai 需要账号已有访问权限。本机模式请先在同一浏览器打开源站。: ExHentai requires an account with access. In local mode, first open the source site in the same browser.
服务代理如需 igneous，请在账号信息中通过 Cookie 字符串一并导入。: If the server proxy needs igneous, include it in the Cookie string in Account. Account overview, toplists and donation information remain on E-Hentai.
无法访问 ExHentai，请在同一浏览器打开 ExHentai 确认账号权限和: Cannot access ExHentai. Open it in the same browser to check account access and login status
请前往设置更新浏览器助手，以支持 ExHentai 本机请求: Update the browser assistant in Settings to enable local ExHentai requests
ExHentai 未返回可用页面，请确认账号访问权限及当前连接方式的登录凭据: ExHentai did not return a usable page. Check account access and credentials for the selected connection
直接前往所选源站画册页面: Open the gallery on the selected source site
源站已将此画册标记为可能令人不适的内容，请确认是否继续。: The source has flagged this gallery as potentially disturbing. Please decide whether to continue.
画册数据不完整，请重新加载。: Gallery data is incomplete. Please reload.
